[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation that the whole lesion be excised with a narrow margin is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "The surgical margin size should be determined based on the thickness of the tumor.",
  "When indicated, sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as the wide excision whenever possible."
]
